note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 28 May 1902; two councillors for each division. A contest was also expected in Jonesborough (James M'Guill, M. P. Rice and Patrick Kearney, all N.), but no result was found; it is not filed. Polled 28 May 1902, counted on Thursday 29 May. Printed "Mullaglass". James Lockhart was the old member. 305 votes recorded, 3 spoilt, 391 on the register; split votes John Lockhart and Clarke 123, Clarke and James Lockhart 22, John and James Lockhart 25; plumpers 39, 28 and 65.
